meta_description: Mills River Towing serving Hendersonville - towing that shows up when you call.
h1_emph: A higher standard of towing in Hendersonville.
hero_lede: Towing done right. Call and we will take a look.
explore_h2: If it will not move, we will move it
about_p1: We handle towing for drivers who need it done right.
about_p2: Every photograph on this site is our own work, and it covers car and light truck transport, heavy and oversize loads. We work out of Hendersonville and the towns around it.

reviews.author: Soundra Jones
reviews.text: We were 1 1/2 hrs into our 12 hr road trip when we had engine failure. Tyler assisted us with our tow. He went over and beyond providing excellent customer service. Additionally, he followed up with us later in the day to make sure we were doing okay. Thank you so much Tyler and we highly recommend Mills River Towing.

reviews.author: Rainbow Dentist
reviews.text: The only one that had any sense was Tyler but he apparently got fired because why??????? (The owner said he got fired) Why not fire the drunk boy that dont know how to drive i will never use this towing company again because they are a bad example of a business

reviews.author: Jose Calhoun
reviews.text: Have to give a shout out to Tyler. Thank you so much Brother. This man and The company he works for went out of their way to ensure. I was taken care of From almost South Carolina to almost Tennessee. Tyler treated me as family Making sure I had water and a couple of pack of crackers may not be much to most, but it meant a great deal to me as I’ve been down on my luck With one thing after Another. Would recommend this company to anyone and especially if Tyler’s driving The man is a joy and has knowledge beyond his years. Thank you again brother and thank you Mills River Towing!!!

reviews.author: charlene rumfelt
reviews.text: I am very impressed with the professionalism in having my Classic car transported to Virginia. Dennis showed great concern in protecting the automobile and stayed in touch with me and the recipient of the car during the transport. I highly recommend them and will definitely use them in the future. Phil in Marion NC

reviews.author: Dillon Colbert
reviews.text: Called Mills river towing last night for my daughter. Tyler answered and gave us an approximate arrival time. He than communicated the entire way and was early to his time given. He treated my daughter with tremendous respect gave her water and let her cool off while he took care of the car. That says a lot about a man and the company to not just tow a vehicle but to place the customer first and actually take care of them. Thank you Tyler!!! & Thank you Mills River!!! Y'all are forever at the top of our list.

reviews.author: Jonathan Greene
reviews.text: Couldn't ask for a more professional and respectful company. Huge thanks to Tyler for not hanging up on me like everyone else did. He was communicative the entire way down and back. He had a huge smile when he pulled up to drop my truck and just easy going. Hard to find men like that now a days. Good ol boys. Thanks Tyler and Mills River for doing what y'all do. You've got a new customer for sure.

reviews.author: Gabby sauve
reviews.text: Chris Was SOOOO amazing!! They came out in the middle of the night and did whatever he could to help get our truck out of an awful spot when our tired rod busted! He then helped us tow it to the exact location that we needed to take it to to get fixed!

reviews.author: scott kelsay
reviews.text: As a business owner myself, I can identify quality people with excellent service. Dennis with Mills River Towing exceeds that bar in everyway. He helped move a vehicle from Asheville to Lexington KY. He was transparent keeping me informed every step of the way. If you have towing needs, do not hesitate he is the person for the job. Thanks again!!!!

reviews.author: Sandra Brown
reviews.text: We had a WONDERFUL experience with this towing company today. We were an hour from our home and the car needed to be driven an additional.hour away. They showed up very quickly to pick us up. They drive us to a drop off location and carried our vehicle the rest of the way. All at a very reasonable price. We treated with great respect and made to feel very comfortable in what was a greatly upsetting situation. I highly recommend this company for ALL of your emergency and towing needs. We are very satisfied with this service and will definitely use them again.

reviews.author: Stephanie Webb
reviews.text: They provided us with amazing service today! Our daughter was in a wreck 5 hours away from us and we could not get to her or her car and they answered immediately and went to her car within the hour and towed it to the dealership!! Thank you so much

reviews.author: Dr. Seth J Fogle
reviews.text: Dennis was fantastic! He was prompt, honest, and safe. He rescued my car and I on the side of the road at 8 pm at night before Thanksgiving. He said he would there in 20 minute. He was there in 20 minutes. The price quoted was fair and what was charged. Good Guy.

reviews.author: Haley Finotti
reviews.text: Mills River Towing is the absolute best towing service in western NC! Drove all the way to Knoxville, TN to help me out when my car quit on me. Very quick to respond and super helpful/friendly service! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Keely Parmelee
reviews.text: ORCHIDS TO THIS GENTLEMAN! I found myself in quite the predicament of needing a tow as my kia Sorento engine seized. I needed the vehicle towed off a farm- as my triple A was not as dependable as I thought. Not only did he charge me a fair price- he IMMEDIATELY left to pick up my vehicle. He called me upon arrival to let me know that my car keys were missing. Long story short (after calling the owner of the farm) someone on the property took the keys out of my car and admitted to planning on selling my suv for parts without my consent. Not only did this gentleman get my vehicle to a safe destination as requested, he went as far as to fix all my broken door handles so he could lock my vehicle and secure it before leaving it with my dear friends. I cannot thank you enough as you probably can’t imagine how much you really helped me as I left there in a hurry for a reason. Professional and caring. 10 out of 10 - THANK YOU!

reviews.author: lydia
reviews.text: Thank you Chris and Dennis for everything!!! These guys are beyond awesome..they went far above what I'd expect from getting a tow..car was totaled, 3000 miles from my home, on a Pisgah dirt road, middle of nowhere..prompt, professional, kind, generous, and very cost effective...besides just retrieving the car asap, they helped me dispose of vehicle, dropped me off at a local hotel, with excellent restaurant recommendations,and by luck, located a replacement vehicle..omg guys, cannot thank you enough for turning a horrible bewildering situation into a massive blessing..

reviews.author: Ironman
reviews.text: Mills River Towing is awesome! The response time, communication, and professionalism is over the top! A big thank you to you and your team!

reviews.author: carson lynch
reviews.text: Tyler pulled up and offered a tow while I was waiting on triple A. Saved me from a few painful hours of waiting and got me to where I needed to be. Thank you Mills River Towing.

reviews.author: Steven Caldwell
reviews.text: Aggressive driving and getting out in traffic is an idiotic thing. The driver of the black ram has major issues. Now know to stay clear of this one hope this helps!!!

reviews.author: Calvin Ruby
reviews.text: Rude driver. Unwilling to allow traffic to merge at accident scene. Will never recommend company with poorly trained employees.
